name: Liquidity
definition: Ability of a financial instrument to be easily traded and converted to cash, at conditions that do not affect its price.

IndicatorType.name: Indicator Type
IndicatorType.definition: Type of liquidity measure, of a financial instrument, on a market.

Upper.name: Upper
Upper.definition: Upper liquidity indicator, represented as a percentage of the average trade daily volume.

Lower.name: Lower
Lower.definition: Lower liquidity indicator, represented as a percentage of the average trade daily volume.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Market value of the securities position for which liquidity details are provided.

WeightedAverageLiquidity.name: Weighted Average Liquidity
WeightedAverageLiquidity.definition: Indicates the overall weighted average liquidity expressed as a percentage of average daily volume.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity of a financial instrument for which liquidity range details are provided.

ListTrading.name: List Trading
ListTrading.definition: List trading process for which liquidity data is provided.
